message.content: The history of cartography, the study and practice of making maps, extends back thousands of years, beginning with simple representations of landscapes, settlements, and routes created by early human communities. Some of the oldest known maps include a Babylonian clay tablet from around the sixth century BCE that depicts parts of the world in symbolic form, while ancient Egyptians produced plans of land and property boundaries for administration and taxation.
